work_lede: Four builds where the call and the code were mine.
work_card1_heading: You find out at the gate. This one tells you first.
work_card1_body: Access changes quietly and gets discovered at a gate. Six documented mandates — audit, research, ideation, specification, evaluation, iteration — converge on one concept: an append-only record where every change carries a reason and a next step. Then I built it.
work_card2_heading: The screenshot says paid. My app asks the bank.
work_card2_body: Yape receipts can be faked field by field — except one. I entered app development to build the merchant-side check that reads it: React, TypeScript, banking-grade security discipline, and a test protocol that proves the claim held.
work_card3_heading: The Airport Trilogy: Apps for Jorge Chavez International
work_card3_body: One airport, three positions. A passenger app I built for myself and tested with four people. A booking redesign written for the selection process that hired me. Then TUUA Transfer, live today, whose payment screens I designed and handed to engineering.
work_card4_heading: Nine repositories, in the order I learned them.
work_card4_body: The ladder from a first console application to this portfolio, one rung per course, each one linking to the repository it produced and naming the single thing it added.
capabilities_lede: The strategist who builds – Not a commodity coder.
cap_s1_body: I confirm feasibility, design the journey, and take it to production — so your decision becomes a shipped product, not a slide deck.
cap_s2_body: I set up tokens, blocks, and rules once, then deploy them smoothly across the firm — making sure your teams adopt and master them.
cap_s3_body: I craft tools to grow what your teams do — sharing AI builds and know-how that boost speed and the work value for all staff.

about_jr_hunt_body: Quality control across 35 projects, holding contractor deliverables to quality standards at South America’s first natural gas liquefaction plant.

about_jr_uvic_body: Coursework: 'Global Leadership and Cultural Intelligence', 'Language, Communication & Global Business', 'Mandarin Chinese I', and others.
about_jr_maas_body: Coursework: 'European Business Context', 'Europe's Entrepreneurial Environment', 'Mandarin Chinese II', and others.
about_jr_esan_lec_body: Calculus I, Creative Processes and other courses to 1,200+ students, plus a term at the Army's Military School.
about_jr_utec_body: 29 teams guided in UX Design and Evaluation across 11 project sections at three levels, generating Community of Practice environments.
about_jr_hec_title: MicroMasters in UX Design and Evaluation
about_jr_hec_body: Prototyping, data analysis and management. The credential that turns my strategy background into a design-research one.
about_jr_limafly_body: A high-fidelity prototype of the full passenger journey. Built on a scalable design system with visual tokens and components with variants.
about_jr_lap_body: Cross-functional role: weekly portfolio tracking, workshop delivery, and direct coordination with leaders to implement new revenue stream.
about_jr_single_body: Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS, token-based visual system, bilingual i18n engine, WCAG AA. 32 active build-days inside a 73-day window and 52 pull requests.
about_jr_tv_body: A React and TypeScript build for merchants to verify that payments are genuine. Secure keypad with randomized digits, double-click prevention, private-data protection. 45/45 automated tests across 6 fraud scenarios and 5 CI checks.
about_jr_accredita_body: A press-accreditation companion for journalists, in the context of the 2026 World Cup. Blazor WebAssembly on .NET 10, ASP.NET Core Web API, TypeScript interop layer. 512 front-end and 33 back-end tests. Three languages at exact parity — EN/ES/PT. Real-time communication (SignalR/WebSockets). Full UX dossier.
about_jr_apex_body: This site – developed and governed end-to-end.
about_jr_bgs_body: Inducted on academic merit through the CENTRUM PUCP Business School chapter. Membership record: CH-5231…385.
evo_m8_body: Bringing the skillset to mature companies.
evo_m3_rv_txt: Full-time across three continents — terms at the University of Victoria in Canada and Maastricht University in the Netherlands — finishing first in class, specialized in Strategic Consulting.
evo_m4_rv_txt: At UTEC, eleven courses across three project levels, mentoring 29 teams end to end through UX design and evaluation. At ESAN, Calculus I to 1,200+ students, in person and remote at scale.
evo_m6_rv_txt: Beyond TUUA, I ran a tracking dashboard across a twelve-project hybrid portfolio, working preventive and corrective action alongside the Product Owners, and articulated the planning phase of five central units into one standard.
evo_m7_rv_txt: Not just tokens: ten organisms, a Gantt and a native motion system, and a 175-key bilingual engine — all hand-written to WCAG AA, governed daily by me alone.
